# Cabinet Summary Template

Use this as `docs/cabinet-summary.md` in each micro-project.

```md

## Status

Active / Promising / Parked / Dead / Shipped

## One-liner

## Repo / branch / PR

- Repo:
- Branch:
- PR:

## Why it exists

## What was built

## How to validate

## What I learned

## Risks or doubts

## Next step

## Verdict

## Source docs

- `docs/project-brief.md`
- `docs/implementation-log.md`
- `docs/decisions.md`
- `docs/validation-notes.md`
- `docs/next-steps.md`
```
